scope: Five inspected development cases from one evidence task; not a holdout or population certification

offline_exclusion.reason: The unchanged full conflict context plus previously observed full native boilerplate exceeds the immutable 20000-byte request cap; excluded before inference
offline_exclusion.comparison_scope: Two matched token-efficiency pairs (complete and missing); minimal contradiction is a separate negative control

selection_policy: Host-declared exact-ref subset through existing legal materialize; retain every available identity declaration and all contradictions and gaps; no learned selector or judge input

mutation_axes.evidence_use_within_size: Only source-identity availability or the existing synthetic contradiction intervention
mutation_axes.efficiency_within_evidence_state: Only optional EvidenceRef membership; excerpts, provenance, contradiction and gap arrays unchanged

wire_policy: A single physical staging/profile path with fresh state each time; first admitted full native request freezes the comparison template. Before every forwarding, the entire native request must match after replacing only its exact evidence block. No other normalization.
stop: Stop on transport, accounting, wire, source, identity, or resource ineligibility. Retain semantic failures and continue planned remaining cases. Never retry or replace a case.
falsifiers: Failure to abstain on missing or contradictory identity
No lower actual prompt-token use in the minimal pair
Any full system or non-evidence request change
no_claims: Backend-provider causal attribution when provider is null
